newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi index edges higher in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi index edges higher in calm trading.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index rose on Thursday in calm trading, brokers said.
They said most stocks held stable with only a few gaining marginally but the market direction was still unclear.
The index rose 0.97 points to 3,073.44. Turnover was 14.669 million shillings on 389,498 shares from 6.728 million shillings on 248,621 shares on Wednesday.
A senior broker said trading was calm with no major changes in market indicators. The week had been slow.
"Most people are now into the agricultural stocks. There's been good improvement from last year," one dealer said. There's a lot of demand but the supply is low."
Brooke Bond eased to 176 on 100 shares while Kakuzi was steady at 92.50. Both posted heavy gains in profits for the first half (January-June) of the year.
In commercials, Kenya Airways traded 68,992 shares at 11.20, 10.80 and 11.10 from 10.90 on Wednesday while Nation Printers & Publishers gained 5.0 to 107 but fell back to 102.
Housing Finance traded at 26, 24 and 25.25 from 25, Kenya Commercial Bank rose 2.50 to 57.50 on 84,357 shares while National Bank of Kenya traded 80.035 shares at 17.50 from 17.65.
Foreign investors dealt 2,800 shares of Diamond Trust at 36.50 and 37 shillings.
